ThirdPartyPayee.title: Third-party payee
ThirdPartyPayee.description: A person the organisation pays who is neither an employee nor an entrepreneur: a guest lecturer, a committee member, a volunteer paid above the tax-free amount. Payments to them are reported to the Belastingdienst once a year (filings-ib47).

initials.title: Initials
initials.description: The payee's initials, for example J.P.
initials.x-notes: UBD ONTVANGER/voorletters (an1..6). ThirdPartyReportService cuts a longer value to five characters plus a hyphen, as the Belastingdienst handbook (Deel 2, 4.5.4) prescribes.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Words before the surname, such as van or de.

bsn.title: BSN
bsn.description: The payee's citizen service number. Without it the payee cannot be reported.
bsn.x-notes: UBD IHPOpvoerWijziging/bSN (9 digits). Same property authorization as Employee.bsn: HR and payroll read and write, nobody else (compliance-roles-and-field-access).

street.title: Street
street.description: Street of the payee's home address.

houseNumber.title: House number
houseNumber.description: House number of the payee's home address.

houseNumberAddition.title: Addition
houseNumberAddition.description: Addition to the house number, such as A or bis.

postcode.title: Postcode
postcode.description: Postcode of the payee's home address.

city.title: City
city.description: Town or city of the payee's home address.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country of the payee's home address, as a two-letter code.

activity.title: Work done
activity.description: What the payee is paid for, such as guest lessons or committee meetings.
activity.x-notes: Shown on the payee's yearly statement; not part of the UBD message.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key (REQ-MULTI-001), a plain string, not a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7). The UBD report is assembled per administration.

ThirdPartyPayment.title: Third-party payment
ThirdPartyPayment.description: One payment to a third-party payee, with any expense allowance paid on top. The yearly report sums them per payee (filings-ib47).

paidOn.title: Paid on
paidOn.description: The date the money was paid out.
paidOn.x-notes: Decides the tax year; the report uses the last payment date of the year as uitbetalingsDatum (Deel 2, 2.3.4).

amount.title: Amount
amount.x-notes: Reported together with expenseAllowance: the UBD amount includes cost allowances (Deel 1, 1.4).

expenseAllowance.title: Expense allowance
expenseAllowance.description: Travel and other costs paid on top of the fee, in euros. They are reported too.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key (REQ-MULTI-001), a plain string.

ThirdPartyReport.title: Third-party payments report
ThirdPartyReport.description: The yearly report of payments to third parties (UBD, formerly IB47) of one administration, in the Belastingdienst's delivery format, due on 31 January of the next year (filings-ib47).

klaarzetten.description: Marks the report ready to upload. UbdReportReadyGuard denies it while the report has no validated message or carries blocking findings.

verzenden.description: Records that the file was uploaded to the Belastingdienst.

heropenen.description: Reopens the report to assemble it again. A sent report assembled again keeps its message ids, so the Belastingdienst treats the new delivery as a correction (Deel 2, 2.3.5).

year.title: Year
year.description: The year whose payments are reported.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the report has got to: draft, ready to upload, or sent.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: The last day to send the report: 31 January of the next year.

lineCount.title: Payees reported
lineCount.description: How many payees the report lists.

totalAmount.title: Total reported
totalAmount.description: The total reported, in whole euros.
totalAmount.x-notes: Sum of the per-payee amounts, each rounded down to whole euros as the format requires (Deel 2, 4.5.3 bedrag).

messageXml.title: Message
messageXml.description: The report in the Belastingdienst's UBD format, validated against its XSD.
messageXml.x-notes: UBD 1.0 (UBD_1.0_V1.20211028.xsd, shipped in lib/Standards/ubd/). Absent while blocking findings remain.

messageFileName.title: File name
messageFileName.description: The file name to upload the message under.

leveringsId.title: Delivery id
leveringsId.description: The id of this delivery, unique for the administration.

assembledAt.title: Assembled at
assembledAt.description: When the report was last assembled.

blockingFindings.title: Blocking findings
blockingFindings.description: Problems that stop the report from being made ready.

warningFindings.title: Warnings
warningFindings.description: Problems worth checking that do not stop the report.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: What the last assembly found, per payee.
